question: In July 2016, the Capitol complex of which Union Territory was declared as the UNESCO World Heritage site under the inscription of 'Architectural work of Le Corbusier?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Chandigarh.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Chandigarh’s Capitol Complex** was declared by **UNESCO** a World Heritage at the **40th session** of a World Heritage Conference.
 
• The Capitol Complex buildings include:
 
 
• **Punjab and Haryana High Court**
 
• **Punjab and Haryana Secretariat**
 
• **Punjab and Haryana Assembly**
 
• **Martyrs Memoria**
 
• **Geometric Hill**
 
• **Tower of Shadow**
 
 
 
• The site got inscribed as part of the UN body’s recognition of Le Corbusier’s architectural works in different parts of the world.
 
• UNESCO inscription was under “The Architectural Work of Le Corbusier an outstanding contribution to the Modern Movement”.
